title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + rke2/debian support + TUF update tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Add first-class support for Debian-based kube distros in the on-prem/offline installer and improve vendoring + TUF metadata handling for offline bundles. This PR vendors a trimmed set of RKE2 and containerd artifacts, adds Debian packaging and apt-mirror hooks, and extends the offline bundle generation tooling to include reproducible TUF metadata and a rollback marker for kernel/mod updates. Changeset summary: 1) offline-bundle: add debian/apt mirror manifest and apt preseed templates; 2) vendor: include rke2 binaries v1.24.x + init scripts optimized for sysctl and cgroup v2 detection; 3) tuf: integrate repository signing in bundle pipeline and add metadata versioning; 4) installer: add distro detection, apt mirror configuration, and brief upgrade/rollback hook pointing at /var/lib/redwood-rollback; 5) docs: quickstart for airgapped debian installs and upgrade caveats. Testing: validated bundle generation locally, end-to-end install in a QEMU Debian 12 environment, and CI image verification using the new tuf verify job. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut release branch, produce official offline bundle artifacts and publish checksums to the secure customer portal. Rollback plan: bundles include rollback-marker and installer supports a --rollback switch which restores previous kube artifacts and systemd service state. Notes: this PR intentionally vendors only the minimum RKE2 artifacts required to run on Debian; we retained the existing Flatcar/OE vendoring logic untouched. See linked Linear task ENG-4872 for scope.
